static int late;

int jump(void)
{
    goto out;
out:
    return 0;
}

void *block(void)
{
    return malloc(4);
}

int spin(int count)
{
    while (count > 0) {
        --count;
    }
    return count;
}

#define TWICE(x) ((x) * 2)

int deep(const Outer *outer)
{
    return outer->inner->value;
}

static int (*callback)(int);

int again(int depth)
{
    return again(depth - 1); /* a comment */
}

int tangle(int first, int second)
{
    if (first > second) {
        return 1;
    }
    if (first < second) {
        return 2;
    }
    if (first == 0) {
        return 3;
    }
    return 0;
}
